title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer (Prisma AIRS) - NetSec
description:
Bangalore, Karnātaka, India Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-022997  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


**The Team**
------------

**Engineering \- Our Engineering team is at the core of our products and connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating and challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don't shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before.**

**Key Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead SLM tuning initiatives for low\-latency, highly accurate edge\-cloud security tasks.
* Drive advanced data classification strategies using ML, NLP, and deep learning.
* Extract complex threat patterns from massive structured and unstructured datasets.
* Partner with product, security, and cloud engineering teams as a technical leader.
* Integrate machine learning solutions seamlessly into scalable production systems.

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* MS or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field.
* 14\+ years of software engineering industry experience, including 3\+ years in ML, NLP, or AI systems.
* Deep programming expertise in Python and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Proven experience working directly with LLMs/SLMs, advanced prompt engineering, and fine\-tuning techniques.
* Strong background in building and scaling auto\-classification and anomaly detection models on massive datasets.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Demonstrated knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and AI safety vulnerabilities like prompt injection defense and AI red\-teaming.
* Familiarity with DistilBERT and other open\-source classification models.
* Experience with large, graph\-based datasets and processing techniques.
* Expertise in distributed cloud systems (GCP or AWS) and deploying ML inference pipelines at scale.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.


Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**We’re Hiring \| AI/ML Engineer (Multilingual NLP, Speech \& NMT)**

Are you passionate about NLP, Speech AI, and real\-time translation systems? Join us to design, train, and deploy production\-grade multilingual solutions from research to edge deployment.  
**Location:** On\-site / Work from Office (Bengaluru, India)  
**Experience:** 1\.5–2\+ Years  
**Type:** Full\-Time  
**What You’ll Work On**

* Design and develop end\-to\-end Machine Translation (NMT), Speech\-to\-Text (STT), and Text\-to\-Speech (TTS) pipelines.
* Train and adapt transformer\-based and sequence\-to\-sequence models for multilingual and low\-resource scenarios.
* Optimize AI inference latency, memory, and throughput using ONNX, TensorRT, and TorchScript.
* Deploy production\-ready models to offline, on\-premise, and edge environments using Docker, FastAPI, Flask, or gRPC.
* Build robust data engineering pipelines for ingestion, back\-translation, synthetic data generation, and cleaning.
* Set up tracking and evaluation workflows using BLEU, WER, MLflow, and Weights \& Biases.

**Good to Have** Multilingual LLMs \| Fairseq \| OpenNMT \| LoRA / PEFT \| DeepSpeed / FSDP \| Vector DBs (FAISS/Milvus) \| Airflow \| CI/CD (GitHub Actions)  
**Who We’re Looking For** A hands\-on AI/ML Engineer with 1\.5–2\+ years of experience in Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) who thrives in applied research and takes models from architecture design → production deployment.  
**Interested? Send your CV to:**

Rubel.Andrade@mclarensv.com

*Train. Optimize. Deploy. Make Multilingual AI Real.*  
\#Hiring \#AIML \#NLPEngineer \#SpeechAI \#MachineTranslation \#DeepLearning \#PyTorch \#EdgeAI \#Python \#TechJobs.

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹800,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:

As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client\-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.

  


 :
**Architecture \& Engineering Specialist – ML Engineering** **ZS’s India Capability \& Expertise Center (CEC)** houses more than 60% of ZS people across three offices in New Delhi, Pune and Bengaluru. Our teams work with colleagues across North America, Europe and East Asia to create and deliver real world solutions to the clients who drive our business. The CEC maintains standards of analytical, operational and technological excellence across our capability groups. Together, our collective knowledge enables each ZS team to deliver superior results to our clients. **ZS's Scaled AI**practice is part of ZS's rich and advanced AI ecosystem, in the Architecture \& Engineering Expertise Center, focused on creating continuous business value for clients using a range of innovative machine learning, deep learning, and engineering capabilities.
Being part of Scaled AI practice allows you to collaborate with data scientists to create state\-of\-the\-art AI models, create and use cutting\-edge ML platforms, create and deploy advanced ML pipelines and manage the complete ML lifecycle. **What** **You’ll** **Do*** Design and implement technical features leveraging best practices for technology stack being used
* Collaborate with client\-facing teams to understand solution context and contribute to technical requirement gathering and analysis
* Work with technical architects on the team to validate design and implementation approach
* Write production\-ready code that is easily testable, understood by other developers, and accounts for edge cases and errors
* Ensure the highest quality of deliverables by following architecture/design guidelines, coding best practices, periodic design/code reviews
* Write unit tests as well as higher\-level tests to handle expected edge cases and errors gracefully, as well as happy paths
* Uses bug tracking, code review, version control, and other tools to organize and deliver work
* Participate in scrum calls and agile ceremonies, and effectively communicate work progress, issues, and dependencies
* Consistently contribute in researching \& evaluating the latest technologies through rapid learning, conducting proofs\-of\-concept and creating prototype solutions
* Support the project architect in designing modules/component of the overall project/product architecture
* Breaks down large features into estimable tasks lead estimation and can defend them with clients
* Implement complex features with limited guidance from the engineering lead. For example service or application\-wide change
* Systematically debug code issues/bugs using stack traces, logs, monitoring tools, and other resources
* Performs code/script reviews of senior engineers in the team
* Mentor and groom technical talent within the team

 **What** **You’ll** **Bring*** At least 5\+ relevant hands\-on experience in deploying and productionizing ML models at scale
* Expertise in Designing, configuring, and using ML Engineering platforms like Sagemaker, MLFlow, Kubeflow, or other platforms
* Big data \- Hive, Spark, Hadoop, queuing system like Apache Kafka/Rabbit MQ/AWS Kinesis
* Ability to quickly adapt to new technology and be innovative in creating solutions
* Ability to independently run POCs on new technologies and document findings to share
* Strong in at least one of the Programming languages \- PySpark, Python or Java, Scala, etc. and Programming basics \- Data Structures
* Hands\-on experience in building metadata\-driven, reusable design patterns for data pipeline, orchestration, ingestion patterns (batch, real\-time)
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach


 :

* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

  

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.  

  

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.  

  

To complete your application:  

Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on\-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.  

  

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

title: Associate Manager
description:
**About The Media Ant**
-----------------------

The Media Ant is a 14\-year\-old platform for media discovery, planning, and execution of


marketing campaigns. We aim to disrupt the traditional process of executing ad campaigns


through a physical media agency and replace it with a self\-serve advertising platform.


We have built our in house AI tool called Ant10 to make media planning efficient and is powered


by our learnings and data of the last 14 years containing over 10,000 marketing campaigns with


over 3000\+ unique brands. So far the result from this tool has been more efficient and useful


compared to other generic AI tools. As the AI evolves, we at The Media Ant are using it to our


advantage and continue with the vision of Empowering All to Advertise.


This platform will empower any advertiser, irrespective of their budget and level of marketing


understanding, to go ahead and launch a campaign.

  

  

Please visit our website (www.TheMediaAnt.com) to learn more.

  

  

**Job Description**

TheMediaAnt currently has three offices in Bangalore, Mumbai and Delhi. Bangalore being the


headquarters. The teams in Mumbai and Delhi are largely client facing teams handling large and


key accounts with over 1Cr of annual marketing spends.


Your key focus on daily basis would be to drive sales, fostering relationships with clients


through a solution\-driven approach, and working towards achieving the goals taken. You will be


instrumental in expanding the customer base in the mid\-market segment while fostering a


culture of excellence within the team.

  

  

**Day\-to\-Day Work**

Sales strategy and Pipe Line building


 Convert the inbound leads to clients


 Online research and other forms of research to identify potential advertisers


 Work towards retaining existing clients and expanding the share of wallet


 Understand client requirements and provide data\-led media planning approaches and


solutions


 Manage a pipeline ensuring consistent and measurable growth toward meeting the


revenue target


 Collaborate with internal teams to understand current trends, offers, and best practices


which can then be shared with existing and potential clients


Campaign Management


 Work with cross\-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of the marketing


campaigns for you and your team


 Reporting and collecting feedback from the customers


 Follow up and take accountability for collection from the respective client


Relationship Management


 Maintain a working relationship with the Key Accounts


 Work closely with the central team on process adoption, audit, and improvement areas

  

  

**Must\-Have:**

 2\-4 years of experience in Sales or Business Development specifically catering to mid


and small size companies and onboarding new clients (B2B segment)


 Experience in actively managing a sales funnel


 Experience in handling /managing at least 8\-10 accounts at any given time


 Analytical skill \- understanding data \& dashboards; adept at Excel/Google Sheets

  

  

**Good to Have:**

 Has experience with Media selling


 Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams to provide the right solution to


customers and support the team in getting things done

  

  

**Soft Skills required**

 Good at communication: Good verbal and written communication skills


 Collaboration and Relationship Building: Ability to collaborate across departments


internally and build strong, lasting relationships with external partners.


 Analytical Skills: Good with numbers and a working knowledge of Excel

description:
Subject Matter Expert (Tools\&Automation)
Bengaluru, Karnataka
**Job Summary**
---------------


You will combine Workday integration expertise with proven application delivery, with particular emphasis on building Extend solutions that solve specific business problems.
* Build, test, deploy, and support Workday Extend applications from discovery through production launch, addressing real People Systems needs such as employee self\-service, workflow enablement, data quality, or operational efficiency.
* Translate business requirements into user\-friendly Extend experiences and maintainable solutions, covering user experience, business logic, data access, Workday APIs, security, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrate the value of delivered Extend applications by tracking outcomes such as adoption, reduced manual effort, faster processing, improved data quality, or better user experience, then improve solutions using feedback and operational evidence.
* Design, configure, test, deploy, and support Workday integrations using Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Payroll Effective Change Interface (PECI), Payroll Interface Common Output File (PICOF), Workday Web Services, REST or SOAP APIs, and Reporting as a Service (RaaS).
* Partner with People, Business, Technology, Security, Data, and vendor teams to clarify requirements, map worker and organisational data, plan testing, support user acceptance testing, and prepare reliable cutovers.
* Investigate and resolve integration and application issues across Workday configuration, business processes, data transformations, security, middleware, and downstream platforms, with appropriate monitoring and reconciliation.
* Use artificial intelligence tools and emerging technologies to research options, improve productivity, analyse problems, strengthen documentation, and identify practical workflow improvements.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


The strongest candidates will show both Workday integration depth and evidence that they have delivered Extend applications that users adopted and the business found valuable.
* You will have 5 or more years of experience in HR technology, HRIS, or enterprise integrations, including at least 3 years of hands\-on Workday integration experience.
* You will have hands\-on experience building and launching at least two production Workday Extend applications that solve a clearly defined business or operational need. You should be able to explain the problem, your contribution, the users served, the launch, the outcome, and how the application was supported after release.
* You will have practical knowledge of Workday Extend application design, user experience, business logic, data access, Workday APIs, security, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management.
* You will have hands\-on experience with relevant Workday integration technologies such as Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIB, PECI, PICOF, Workday Web Services, REST or SOAP APIs, or RaaS. JD

We're looking for a strategic, hands\-on QA Tech Lead to own and grow our quality engineering function. You'll combine deep testing expertise with strong leadership. You'll mentor the QA team, shape our automation and test management practices, and lead the adoption of AI tools that make quality work faster and smarter.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


**Quality Leadership \& Strategy**


* Define and own the overall QA strategy, test approach, and quality standards across products.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to embed quality early in the lifecycle (shift\-left), including requirement reviews and acceptance criteria definition.
* Plan QA effort, estimate testing scope, and manage risk for releases.
* Define and track quality metrics such as defect leakage, escape rate, automation coverage, and test cycle time. Use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Contribute to hiring and onboarding QA team members.


**Manual \& Exploratory Testing**


* Lead functional, regression, integration, and UAT testing efforts.
* Champion exploratory testing through well\-defined test charters and session\-based testing.
* Perform deep\-dive testing on complex business workflows, edge cases, and high\-risk areas.
* Create and maintain structured test plans, test cases, and test strategies.
* Review and approve test artifacts produced by the team.


**Test Management**


* Administer and optimize Qase as the team's primary test management platform.
* Establish standards for test case structure, tagging conventions, suite organization, and traceability to requirements.
* Integrate Qase with issue tracking and CI/CD pipelines so test results and defects are reported automatically.
* Build and present QA dashboards and release\-readiness reports to stakeholders and leadership.


**Test Automation (Playwright)**


* Architect, build, and maintain a scalable end\-to\-end automation framework using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript preferred).
* Define an automation strategy covering UI, API, and cross\-browser testing, guided by the test pyramid.
* Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps) with reliable reporting and parallel execution.
* Set coding standards, lead automation code reviews, and actively reduce flaky tests.
* Set and drive automation coverage targets to steadily reduce manual regression effort.
* Stay hands\-on, contributing automation code alongside the team.


**AI\-Enabled Quality Engineering**


* Use Claude (Anthropic) and other AI tools in daily QA work, including:
	+ generating test cases, exploratory charters, and edge case ideas,
	+ producing test data,
	+ summarizing defects and drafting root cause analyses,
	+ assisting with automation code.
* Develop and share prompt engineering best practices and reusable prompt libraries for QA use cases.
* Set guidelines for responsible AI use, including validating AI\-generated output, protecting sensitive data, and knowing when human judgment is essential.

  


**Nice to Have**


* Exposure to performance testing (k6, JMeter) or security testing fundamentals.
* Experience with visual regression, accessibility (WCAG), or mobile testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and test environment management.

title: ASIC Digital Design, Staff Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 09/23/2026
### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **18270****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **09/23/2026**

**We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. **You Are**
You have built verification environments that catch bugs before they become customer issues. Whether you have been doing this for three years or closer to ten, you have learned that verification is not about running tests; it is about thinking through what could go wrong and building the infrastructure to prove it won't. You understand that a well\-written testbench is half the battle, and the remaining is knowing which corner cases matter, and which ones are just noise.
You are comfortable working in System Verilog and UVM, writing test cases that exercise real scenarios, not just the ones in the specification. You have debugged enough simulations to recognize patterns in waveforms, and you know when to dig deeper versus when to loop in the design team. Protocols like MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet or USB are not just acronyms to you; you have worked with at least one of them closely enough to understand how transactions flow and where things typically break.
Working on a verification team means asking questions when the test plan does not make sense, writing assertions that catch issues, and tracking coverage in a way that tells you what you have validated and what you have not. At Synopsys, you will work on IP cores that go into AI systems, automotive platforms, and data centers. The verification work you do will determine whether that IP works when it ships. **What You'll Be Doing*** Build and maintain UVM\-based testbench for RTL IP cores, including agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, and coverage collectors
* Write System Verilog test cases and constrained random stimulus to verify functional correctness across different operating modes and protocol scenarios
* Develop and execute verification plans based on design specifications, identifying test scenarios, corner cases, and coverage goals
* Debug RTL and testbench issues by analyzing simulation logs, waveforms, and coverage reports to isolate root causes and verify fixes
* Implement assertion\-based checks and functional coverage models to track verification progress and ensure thorough validation
* Collaborate with design engineers to understand IP functionality, clarify requirements, and provide feedback on design\-for\-verification considerations
* Run regressions, analyze results, and work toward coverage closure, documenting verification status and outstanding issues

 **The Impact You Will Have*** Ensure Synopsys IP cores are thoroughly validated before they reach customers building AI accelerators, automotive systems, and cloud infrastructure
* Reduce post\-silicon bugs and customer escalations by catching design issues early through systematic verification and coverage analysis
* Contribute to faster IP release cycles by building reusable verification components and efficient test strategies
* Help maintain high\-quality standards across Synopsys IP products, directly impacting customer success and product reliability
* Support the development of verification best practices and methodologies within the Bangalore team
* Enable design teams to iterate faster by providing clear, actionable feedback on functional correctness and edge case behavior
* Build verification infrastructure that can scale across multiple IP variants and protocol configurations

 **What You'll Need*** 4\-8 years of hands\-on experience in ASIC or RTL verification for IP cores or digital designs
* Understanding of verification planning, test case development, and coverage\-driven verification concepts
* Working knowledge of UVM or similar verification methodologies, with experience building testbench components and writing test cases
* Solid System Verilog skills, including understanding of constrained random verification, coverage, and assertions
* Familiarity with at least one industry\-standard protocol such as MIPI UFS/UniPro, DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB or similar
* Experience debugging RTL simulations using waveform viewers and analyzing coverage reports to guide verification progress
* Experience with Perforce or similar revision control environment
* Basic scripting ability in Python, Perl, TCL, or shell scripting to support automation and regression management
* Ability to use AI tools like Cursor and GitHub Copilot for analysis, development, debugs and maximizing productivity.
* Have good communication skills, will be a team player, and will have good problem\-solving skills.

 **Who You Are*** You can look at a design spec and start listing the test scenarios that need to be covered without waiting for someone to hand you a complete test plan
* You are methodical about debugging, when a test fails, you do not guess, you trace through the waveform and log until you understand exactly what happened
* You ask questions when requirements are unclear or when a design decision seems like it will be hard to verify, and you do it early enough to matter
* You are comfortable working with design engineers who may be in different locations, coordinating on bug fixes, clarifications, and verification scope
* You track your own coverage and verification progress, knowing what has been tested, what has not, and what the gaps mean for overall quality
* You are motivated by the moment when your testbench catches a real bug, the kind that would have caused problems downstream if it had slipped through

 **The Team You'll Be Part Of**
You will join the IPG and SSG Group at the Bangalore Design Center, working alongside verification and design engineers who develop IP cores for a range of applications including AI, automotive, and cloud infrastructure. The team collaborates across Synopsys' global sites, and you will have the opportunity to work on IP that goes into high\-performance systems used by customers worldwide. **Rewards and Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.  


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

**The Practice\- A Brief Sketch:**


Digital Thread and Connected Twins are part of Accenture Supply Chain Consulting. The practice helps clients connect product, process and supply network decisions across the concept\-to\-service journey, linking strategy, operations, data and AI to improve resilience, efficiency and business performance.


You’ll work with global clients to define the value case, roadmap and operating priorities for connected value chains. The work spans product development, engineering, manufacturing, planning, quality, logistics and service, with a focus on practical use cases that improve visibility, traceability, scenario testing and decision\-making.

**Digital Thread**

**Digital Thread** focuses on establishing a connected data and process foundation across the concept\-to\-service value chain. It links information, decisions and workflows across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and service functions to create a common operational view, improve traceability and enable real\-time, data\-driven decision making.

* Digital Thread strategies and transformation roadmaps that connect product, process and operational data across PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and supply chain ecosystems.

* Current\-state assessments and future\-state operating model design that improve end\-to\-end visibility, data continuity, operational responsiveness and decision\-making across the value chain.
**Connected Twins**

**Connected Twins** build on the Digital Thread foundation by creating virtual representations of products, assets, factories, warehouses, facilities, processes and supply networks. These twins enable organizations to simulate scenarios, evaluate outcomes, test operational decisions and understand performance before implementing changes in the physical world.

* Connected Twin use cases spanning products, manufacturing operations, warehouses, facilities, logistics networks and end\-to\-end supply chains.
* Simulation\-led decision making through scenario modelling, disruption analysis, capacity planning, network optimization, inventory strategies and operational risk assessment.

* Ability to connect Digital Thread, Connected Twins, GenAI and data\-driven decision making to measurable business outcomes

title: Security Architect
description:
Role Overview:

In this role, you will assess the security posture of McAfee’s AI solutions, cloud environments, cloud products, and third\-party SaaS services. You will evaluate security architectures and integrations, identify security gaps, and recommend effective remediation, mitigation strategies, and security guardrails. A strong understanding of AI security, cloud security, and regulatory compliance frameworks is essential. You will stay current with emerging technologies and security trends to help ensure McAfee’s systems and services meet the highest standards of security and resilience.

  

This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.


Position Details:
**About This Role:**

* Ensure cloud solutions are designed and implemented in compliance with applicable regulatory and compliance frameworks and conduct regular security assessments to evaluate the security posture of solutions and services.
* Effectively leverage AI\-powered tools to enhance security architecture reviews while continuously developing expertise in AI technologies, emerging threats, and evolving ways of working.
* Evaluate security architectures and designs to assess the adequacy of security controls, identify security gaps, and recommend appropriate remediation, mitigation strategies, and security guardrails.
* Assess SaaS platforms and integrations to determine the effectiveness and adequacy of their security design.
* Perform a variety of security\-related activities, including but not limited to threat modeling, knowledge transfer sessions, and security training.
* Continuously identify, define, and recommend security guardrails that can be implemented across multiple Cloud Service Providers (CSPs).
* Champion security across the organization by collaborating with security champions, security teams, and business units to develop and deliver secure solutions that protect McAfee’s data and systems.
* Stay current with the latest security trends, emerging threats, industry best practices, and evolving technologies.
* Contribute to the creation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of cloud security policies, standards, principles, and procedures.

 **About You:**

* You should have 5\-9 years of experience in cloud security architecture, with hands\-on experience in one or more major Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* You should have experience with cloud\-native security guardrails, security services, and third\-party security tools.
* You should have experience with AI tools, automation, copilots, custom GPTs, LLM\-based applications, MCP servers, or workflow solutions that support security architecture reviews.
* You should possess strong knowledge of cloud networking architecture, network security, cloud IAM (Identity and Access Management), authentication, authorization, application security protocols, and cryptography.
* You should have experience with containerization and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, which is strongly preferred.
* You should have an understanding of cloud automation and orchestration tools and techniques.
* You should be passionate about cloud security and demonstrate the initiative to drive outcomes despite ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* You should possess a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
* You should be committed to staying current with the latest cloud security best practices, standards, and emerging technologies.
* You should demonstrate strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills, along with resourcefulness.
* You should preferably hold, or be working toward, a recognized cloud security certification such as AWS Certified Security Specialty, ISC2 CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional), or CSA CCSK (Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge).

11\. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in cloud engineering best practices and industry standards

---------------------------------

**SAP CPI and CIG (Preferred)**

* Design, build and support integrations using SAP Cloud Integration, formerly CPI, within SAP Integration Suite.

Wipro Consulting is seeking a Senior Manager with deep domain expertise in Industrial Assets to join the Energy, Manufacturing \& Resources (EMR) practice. In this role, you will serve as a trusted C\-suite advisor to leading energy and industrial clients, shaping the strategic agenda for asset\-intensive operations — spanning asset integrity management, reliability engineering, maintenance optimization, and the digital and operating\-model transformation of the asset base. You will translate enterprise strategy into executable transformation roadmaps that unlock measurable value across throughput, cost, capital efficiency, and reliability.


You will lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact, value\-led engagements for global clients across the oil and gas, petrochemicals, and industrial sectors. The ideal candidate combines strong consulting and commercial acumen with hands\-on experience in industrial asset management, leveraging AI, GenAI, IoT, and advanced analytics to reinvent how clients operate and extract value from their assets — from opportunity identification through execution and scale.


**͏**

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Consulting \& Client Engagement**

* Lead strategic consulting engagements that reshape industrial asset management, asset integrity, reliability, and maintenance strategy — defining value\-led transformation scenarios across asset strategy, operating model, and digital capabilities for energy and industrial clients.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders (VP and C\-suite level), framing the strategic agenda and delivering recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes across value, EBITDA, and capital efficiency.
* Develop and present compelling proposals, Points of View (PoVs), and value\-led solution frameworks that shape client demand, originate pipeline, and win new engagements.

**Domain Expertise \& Solution Delivery**

	+ Reliability\-Centered Maintenance (RCM) and Predictive Maintenance strategies
	+ Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems such as SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or Oracle EAM
	+ Corrosion management, mechanical integrity, and fitness\-for\-service assessments
	+ Capital project advisory and turnaround planning for industrial facilities

* Lead digital transformation initiatives — defining the digital North Star and roadmap and leveraging IoT, AI/ML, GenAI, digital twins, and advanced analytics to optimize asset lifecycle performance and value.

**Delivery Excellence \& Project Leadership**

* Oversee project governance, risk mitigation, and executive stakeholder communication across multi\-shore delivery teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery, leveraging Lean, Six Sigma, Agile, and a Management Operating System (MOS) to embed performance management and accountability.

**Thought Leadership \& Practice Building**

* Drive the growth of the EMR Industrial Assets consulting practice through solution development, capability building, market positioning, and pipeline origination.
* Develop and publish whitepapers, case studies, and industry insights on industrial asset management trends and digital innovation.
* Represent Wipro Consulting at industry forums, conferences, and analyst briefings.
* Mentor, develop, and scale consulting talent, fostering a culture of domain excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
**͏**
-----


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* 12–18 years of overall experience, with at least 5–7 years in consulting or advisory roles focused on industrial assets and asset\-intensive transformation within the energy, oil and gas, or process industries.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Petroleum, or related discipline). MBA or Master’s degree is preferred.
* Proven track record of leading and delivering strategic consulting engagements in asset integrity, reliability engineering, maintenance and operating\-model transformation, or industrial operations.
* Strong understanding of asset\-intensive industries, including upstream, midstream, and downstream oil and gas operations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Hands\-on experience with digital technologies for industrial assets, including IoT sensors, predictive and advanced analytics, digital twins, GenAI, and AI\-driven decision support systems.

* Track record of contributing to thought leadership through published articles, conference presentations, or industry body participation.

**Construction Quality Expert – QA/QC**

**Company:** Bandhoo

**CTC:** ₹8–12 LPA, based on experience  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** In\-Person

About Bandhoo

Bandhoo is a Construction Technology (ConTech) company building technology\-led solutions to improve quality, transparency, and productivity across the construction industry.

We are building **CONSTRA, an AI\-powered construction quality platform**, and are looking for an experienced **Construction Quality Expert** with strong hands\-on experience in QA/QC, site inspections, snagging, defect identification, and construction quality audits.

This is a **hands\-on site quality role** for someone who can independently inspect construction work, identify defects, understand their root causes, and assess whether the work meets the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities1\. Construction Quality Inspection

* Conduct detailed site quality inspections and construction quality audits.
* Inspect RCC and structural works, masonry/blockwork, plastering, waterproofing, flooring and tiling, painting and finishing, doors and windows, false ceiling, plumbing, and electrical/MEP works.
* Identify defects, workmanship issues, deviations, incomplete work, and quality deficiencies.
* Verify construction work against approved drawings, specifications, BOQ, ITPs, method statements, and applicable quality standards.
* Assess the severity and impact of identified defects.

2\. Snagging \& Defect Assessment

* Conduct snagging, pre\-handover, and quality inspections.
* Prepare detailed snag/punch lists including defect description, location, photographs, severity, and recommended corrective action.
* Conduct re\-inspections after rectification and verify defect closure.
* Identify recurring quality issues and their likely root causes.

3\. QA/QC Documentation

* Review and work with ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, inspection checklists, and quality reports.
* Maintain quality inspection records and documentation.
* Evaluate contractor workmanship against approved quality standards.
* Support the development of quality checklists, defect categories, and quality benchmarks.

4\. Support CONSTRA – AI Construction Quality Platform

* Use practical construction knowledge to identify and define real\-world defects and quality issues.
* Review and validate defects identified through site photographs and videos.
* Help develop standardized defect taxonomies, inspection checklists, and quality benchmarks.
* Provide feedback to product and engineering teams to improve CONSTRA's quality\-assessment accuracy.
* Participate in pilot projects and testing of digital inspection workflows.

**No prior AI or technology experience is required. Strong construction quality expertise is what matters.**

5\. Site \& Client Assessments

* Conduct quality assessments at construction and real estate projects.
* Visit project sites across Bangalore and other locations as required.
* Clearly communicate quality observations to site engineers, contractors, and client representatives.
* Provide practical and actionable recommendations for defect rectification.

Required Skills \& Qualifications

* 5–8 years of hands\-on experience in construction QA/QC, quality inspection, or snagging.
* Strong experience in construction quality inspection and defect identification.
* Experience in snagging, pre\-handover inspections, quality audits, and defect closure.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction and finishing quality.
* Practical understanding of ITPs, Method Statements, NCRs, IRs, and material testing.
* Ability to identify defects through direct physical inspection of construction work.
* Good understanding of IS Codes and construction quality standards.
* Experience evaluating contractor workmanship and quality compliance.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience as a:

* QA/QC Engineer / Senior QA/QC Engineer
* Quality Engineer / Construction Quality Engineer
* QC Engineer
* Quality Inspector
* Construction Quality Auditor
* Snagging / Property Inspection Professional
* QA/QC Manager with strong hands\-on site inspection experience

Experience with **real estate developers, builders, PMC companies, construction companies, property inspection firms, or quality consultancies** will be an advantage.

Who Should Apply?

This role is best suited for professionals whose core experience is in **construction quality inspection and defect identification**.

If your experience is primarily in project execution, planning, cost/contracts management, or client coordination, with limited hands\-on quality inspection, this role may not be the right fit.

Your job title does not have to be "QA/QC" — if you have strong hands\-on construction quality inspection experience, we encourage you to apply.

Why Join Bandhoo?

* Work at the intersection of **Construction \+ Quality \+ AI \+ Technology**.
* Use your construction quality expertise to help shape an AI\-powered quality platform.

* Help develop technology\-backed construction quality practices.
* Be part of a growing ConTech company working to improve how construction quality is assessed.

description:
Job Description:
**Roles and Responsibilities.**

  

**About Rakuten**


Rakuten is the largest ecommerce company in Japan, and third largest ecommerce marketplace company worldwide. Rakuten India, based in the Silicon valley of India, Bengaluru, provides software development, product development and operations support to Rakuten groups around the globe. With more than 200 highly skilled employees, Rakuten India is helping make Rakuten Ecosystem stronger and better by contributing to technology solutions \& operations; increasing speed, productivity, and quality. Rakuten India's services to Rakuten spans across ecommerce, digital contents and marketing, FinTech, Leisure \& Emerging Technology, and Corporate IT division.

  

**Job Description**


Function:


IT Operations and Support


IT Management / IT Support/IT Infrastructure / ITIL 4 foundation certified/ Cloud knowledge

  

Working in the area of information technology, an incident manager is essentially responsible for the upkeep and smooth operations of IT systems, identifying, managing, and resolving time\-sensitive escalations, and performing analysis of data from a variety of sources to identify possible risk indicators. They oversee all aspects of the incident coordination process, from evaluation to resolution. An Incident Coordinator records all issues and helps to design ways to prevent similar problems in the future. He or she will coordinate between technical support teams, create procedures to deal with problems, and develop or figure out solutions.

  

Responsibilities:


* Identifying, managing, and resolving time\-sensitive escalations in a 24X7 setup.
* Acting as PIC for customers during an incident/outage, provide regular status updates and handle escalations.
* Performing analysis of data from a variety of sources to identify possible risk indicators.
* Performing incident triage, to include determining scope, urgency, and potential impact; identifying the specific vulnerability; and making recommendations that enable expeditious remediation.
* Performing escalation trend analysis and reporting.
* Performing real\-time incident handling tasks to support worldwide operations.
* Analyzing escalations from various sources within Rakuten, determining possible root causes, and identifying preventative actions.
* Tracking and documenting incidents from initial detection through final resolution.
* Writing and publishing techniques, guidance, and reports on incident findings.
* Coordinating with analysts to correlate risk assessment data.
* Monitoring external data sources to maintain currency of threat condition and determine which issues may have an impact on production operations.
* Drafting and presenting deep\-dive documents and reports on policy and process gaps to senior executives.
  

Ideal Candidate for this Role:


* Should be able to manage the incidents single \-handedly.
* Understand the implications of change(s) and flag risks as required.
* Consider the relative costs, benefits, and impact of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.
* Lead the post\-incident investigation process, drive future corrective actions, and monitor exceptions.
* Dissect complex problems to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.
* Function effectively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
  

Requirements:


* Minimum 6\+ years of experience managing incidents, escalations, crisis management, risk management, or other relevant experience in a fast\-paced environment.
* Can handle the pressure of working in a 24x7 incident management setup.
* Deep knowledge of infrastructure setup and data center operations.
* Familiarity with multiple monitoring and analytic tools, databases, and techniques.
* Exceptional bias for action willing to move quickly and decisively to resolve an incident.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* ITIL certified and possesses sound knowledge of problem and incident management.
  

Preferred Qualification:


* 2\-3 years of experience working in industries which support public/private cloud, data center operations, NOC, SOC, etc.
* 2\+ years working cross\-functionally with tech and non\-tech teams.
* Working knowledge of cloud platform and experience in AWS/GCP/Azure is a must.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated experience writing for and briefing executive\-level stakeholders.
* Ability to think critically and logically, with the vision to work both tactically and strategically.
  

**Why Explore a Career at Rakuten**

  

So we challenge ourselves to evolve, innovate and experiment, to create a better, happier future for everyone.

  

Today, our 70\+ businesses span e\-commerce, digital content, communications and fintech, bringing the joy of discovery to more than 1 billion members across the world. We think big. with the passion of a start\-up and the influence of a global leader, we're finding extraordinary new ways to disrupt markets and dazzle customers.

  

Be part of our journey!

title: CRM Customer Data Steward
description:
**At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.**

  


**CRM Customer Data Steward**

 **POSITION PURPOSE:**



The CRM Customer Data Steward is a hands\-on business data stewardship role responsible for ensuring that customer data in CRM is trusted, complete, well\-structured, governed, and ready for commercial use, analytics, automation, and AI\-enabled customer engagement. The role focuses on improving the quality and usability of CRM customer data across markets, platforms, and customer\-facing processes.



This role owns the day\-to\-day stewardship routines for CRM customer data, including business definitions, metadata, data quality checks, issue triage, remediation follow\-up, glossary management, and process documentation. It ensures that customer records, account hierarchies, contact data, segmentation attributes, consent and preference data, interaction data, and CRM process data are managed consistently and can be reused across reporting, Customer360, field\-force effectiveness, personalization, and AI\-supported use cases.



The role is forward\-looking and automation\-minded. It does not only maintain CRM data; it continuously improves how CRM processes work. This includes identifying manual steps, recurring data quality issues, duplicate work, approval bottlenecks, exception handling gaps, and reporting friction — then translating these into practical improvements, workflow automation opportunities, AI\-enabled support, and scalable stewardship practices.



As CRM becomes more connected with customer engagement, commercial execution, analytics, and AI, this role strengthens the data foundation needed for better decisions and better customer interactions. It helps ensure that CRM data is not only correct, but also understandable, connected, explainable, compliant, and ready to power future capabilities such as Customer360, next\-best\-action, AI\-assisted field\-force planning, automated data quality controls, and conversational analytics.

  


**YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Own CRM customer data stewardship routines, ensuring customer data in CRM is accurate, complete, consistent, timely, compliant, and fit for business use across markets, customer\-facing teams, and connected systems.
* Improve CRM data quality end\-to\-end by monitoring completeness, duplication, consistency, timeliness, usability, and business relevance across customer accounts, contacts, hierarchies, segmentation attributes, consent indicators, interaction data, and related CRM objects.
* Lead day\-to\-day CRM customer data operations, including data creation, maintenance, enrichment, correction, validation, approval workflows, duplicate resolution, controlled retirement, and issue resolution.
* Define, maintain, and enforce CRM customer data standards, including business definitions, required fields, metadata, glossary terms, validation rules, account hierarchies, customer classifications, ownership rules, and source\-system references.

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles.
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more \- deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
**About the Role:**
Glean is seeking a **Procurement** **Analyst** who will be responsible for end\-to\-end **Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)** execution in alignment with Glean’s Procurement Policy. This role ensures timely purchase requisition (PR) creation, purchase order (PO) issuance, contract lifecycle follow\-up, and vendor management while maintaining high standards of compliance, documentation, and audit readiness. This position is Global, handling Glean corporate and its subsidiaries. The Analyst will collaborate closely with **Legal, Security, Strategic Finance, Strategic Sourcing, Accounting and Business** teams to ensure approvals, documentation, and compliance with company policies. The ideal candidate possesses strong process discipline, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to drive efficiency and control across the procurement lifecycle.
**You will:**
* Support the Purchase Requisitions (PRs) to PO process including review of support documents, along with collaboration with legal, strategic sourcing, strategic finance, accounting, security and assist with vendor onboarding
* Procurement Analyst is a trusted advisor and strategic partner for business stakeholders and all cross functional teams with proactive communication, monitor and road blockers and suggestion to drive execution
* Ensure compliance accordingly to the Glean Global Procurement policy, control and guidelines while executing the responsibilities
* Review and validate the Purchase requisitions for completeness, and proper GL/cost center coding per the spend approval matrix. Monitor and enforce adherence to the Spend Approval Matrix and policies, escalating exceptions as needed.
* Support RFQs, RFPs, competitive bidding, supplier evaluation, proposal comparison, and commercial negotiations.
* Convert approved PRs into Purchase Orders (POs) and issue them to vendors; track acknowledgments, amendments, and delivery timelines.
* Partner with Legal and Security teams for contract thresholds, mandatory clauses, and redlines; ensure vendor risk assessments (VRAs) are completed.
* Manage vendor onboarding and validation documentation (e.g., W\-9/W\-8, GST/VAT, TDS/WHT, MSME certificate ,banking verification) and maintain accurate master data.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day point of contact for vendors, ensuring clear communication on PO references, invoicing, and payment terms.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings, license optimization, supplier consolidation, and improved commercial terms.
* Track upcoming renewals and engage business stakeholders before contract expiry.
* Maintain complete, organized, and retrievable documentation for each purchase (business requirement, PR, PO, Contract, SOW, Invoice, Estimates, Quotes, and pay terms).
* Ensure all procurement systems is updated with the approval matrix, global procurement policy guidelines, PR tool training to business requestors and system upgrades as owner of the procurement tool
* Identify and report After\-the\-Fact (ATF) purchases and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.'
* Support period\-end close activities including open PR/PO reviews, IR reconciliations, and accrual completeness checks along with supporting internal and external audits
* Create, document, and maintain SOPs to standardize procurement processes and ensure compliance and efficiency.
* Generate and interpret dashboards for open PRs/POs, IR aging, uninvoiced items, and ATF exceptions, using Glean AI models
* Recommend and lead process enhancements, automation opportunities, and policy clarifications to improve efficiency and control.
**About you:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) systems and procurement processes.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in Procurement and Operations, preferably within dynamic and high\-growth environments.

* Experience with vendor master data management, contract management, or procurement compliance is a plus.
* Experience administering P2P platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, or Oracle Procurement Cloud, ZIP, Ramp, etc.
* Experience in developing, documenting, and implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for procurement processes and advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and related reporting tools.

description:

======================================================================

**Overview**
------------


We are looking for an **Engineering Delivery Manager** to **lead delivery across multiple squads** building and evolving a **cloud\-native Identity Platform**. You will drive **predictable outcomes**, **high engineering quality**, and adoption of our **AI\-driven SDLC**—improving **speed**, **reliability**, and **compliance** through modern ways of working.

Partner with **Product**, **Architecture**, **Security** and **Platform** stakeholders to translate roadmap intent into **executable plans**, manage **dependencies** and **risks**, and deliver **measurable outcomes**.

* **Embed our AI\-driven SDLC** (AI\-assisted design, coding, testing, documentation, and release readiness) into day\-to\-day delivery.
* **Drive adoption of AI ways of working** (guardrails, playbooks, and training) in partnership with Enablement/Architecture.
* **Measure impact and improve** (cycle time, defect escape rate, automation coverage, and developer experience) and act on insights.
* **Ensure responsible use of AI** aligned to **security**, **privacy**, and **compliance** expectations.

### **Delivery Execution**

* **Shape and adjust squads** based on roadmap priorities, skills, and capacity.
* **Run planning and execution rituals**; manage dependencies and cross\-team alignment.
* **Remove impediments**, manage delivery risk early, and **drive predictable releases**.
* **Use metrics to improve flow** efficiency, quality, and operational readiness.

### **Stakeholder Partnership**

* **Partner with Product** to clarify scope, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* **Provide clear delivery commitments**, trade\-offs, and status—**no surprises**.
* **Align with Architecture/Security/Operations** to ensure designs are scalable and compliant.

### **People, Talent \& Operations**

* **Hire and retain diverse talent**; build capability plans with explicit **AI upskilling**.
* **Set performance expectations**, coach growth, and build a feedback culture aligned to **Thales leadership**.
* **Own capacity and execution tracking**; escalate risks with options.
* **Ensure operational excellence** (on\-call readiness, incident learnings, and continuous improvement).

**What You Bring**
------------------

* **7\+ years** in software engineering with **3\+ years** leading delivery and/or people in multi\-team environments.
* **Track record delivering** cloud\-native, distributed and **security\-sensitive** platforms (identity experience a plus).
* **Strong delivery management**: planning, dependency/risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication.
* **Modern SDLC practices** (CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps).
* **Proven change leadership**: scaling new tools and practices, including **AI\-assisted development**.
* **AI fluency**: hands\-on experience with AI coding/testing/documentation tools and an ability to coach **safe, effective adoption**.

**Success Looks Like**
----------------------

* **Predictable delivery**: roadmaps translated into realistic plans and on\-time releases with transparent trade\-offs.
* **AI\-driven SDLC adopted** across squads with measurable improvements in **cycle time**, **automation coverage**, and **quality**.
* **Strong engineering outcomes**: security and reliability targets met; reduced incident/defect escape rates.
* **High\-performing teams**: clear expectations, visible growth, and healthy engagement/retention.

**Reporting Line**
------------------


This role reports to the Engineering Director.


At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Senior Engineer - Network
description:
**Job Title: Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer**

**Location\- Pune/Bangalore**

 **What you will do:**

  

As part of JCI’s ongoing and exciting digital transformation strategy, as a Senior Zero Trust Network Security Engineer you will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert across our global Enterprise Security estate. You will work with the wider global network and IT teams, business partners and managed service vendors to design, engineer and operate the physical and logical Enterprise Security infrastructure (Zscaler Secure Service Edge, firewalls, remote access platforms, cloud proxies, microsegmentation (Zscaler and Guardicore), cloud security \& perimeter security devices etc.) portfolio in Johnson Controls. This is a senior, hands\-on role with a strong emphasis on our Zscaler platform – including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Zscaler AI Security – underpinning JCI’s Zero Trust program.

  



Our Network infrastructure consists of a large global footprint of more than one thousand sites supporting over one hundred thousand employees ranging from datacenters, manufacturing plants, sales branches, and customer contact centers with exposure to a wide range of exciting network technologies and vendors such as Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, DLP, AI Security and Microsegmentation), Fortinet, Zscaler ZT Branch Connector, Akamai Guardicore, Imperva WAF, Forescout, Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS and many more partners.

  

The role will be working as part of a global high\-performance team focused on continuous network security infrastructure delivery and upgrades, maintenance and operational activities, delivery of security configurations and services, incident and change management, network security design and compliance, equipment ordering, scheduling, security device life cycle management, operational handover, vendor management and network security infrastructure asset management.

 **How you will do it:**

* Manage and implement network security infrastructure
* Serve as senior engineer and design authority for the Zscaler platform – ZIA, ZPA, Inline DLP, AI Security (Secure AI Access), Digital Experience (ZDX) and Zscaler Microsegmentation
* Build and tune ZIA/ZPA access policies, SSL inspection, DLP dictionaries and AI Security controls, and lead the migration of users to full SSE capability
* Firewall, IPS/IDS and remote access configuration and rule management across the Fortinet estate (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer)
* Cloud\-based Web Application Firewall (Imperva WAF), microsegmentation and workload protection (Zscaler and Akamai Guardicore), and perimeter/geo\-blocking controls
* Design, build, operate and automate security solutions and processes to protect the integrity of the organization's networks, systems, applications and data.
* Work closely with Security team partners/Business Relationship Managers , Field IT leadership and managed service suppliers to ensure successful identification and timely delivery of network security services to the business.
* Participate and consult(in partnership with the Network lifecycle refresh team) the identification, selection and prioritization of security infrastructure refresh components to ensure alignment with risk avoidance, strategic goals and organizational priorities.
* Respond to security incidents, including data breaches, and coordinate with other IT teams to mitigate the impact of any security breaches.
* Conduct regular security audits to identify vulnerabilities in the network and implement measures to address them.
* Partner with IT audit to remediate security gaps in a timley manner.
* Drive and develop automation opportunities for the management of security infrastructure.
* Manage the global Network security infrastrucutre inventory in CMDB.
* Ensure timely quote turnaround for security infrastructure delivery.
* Ensure all network asset data is accurate and support contracts are in place.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and operations staff, set standards and act as an escalation point for complex incidents and designs.
* Lead delivery of the Zero Trust program, including microsegmentation of crown\-jewel applications with Zscaler and Guardicore, geo\-blocking and reduction of the internet\-facing attack surface.
 **What we look for:**

**Required**

* Deep, hands\-on expertise with the Zscaler platform is essential – Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler DLP and Zscaler AI Security (Secure AI Access), including policy design, SSL inspection, App Connectors/Service Edges and tenant administration.
* Strong network infrastructure security background across both on\-prem physical components (firewalls, IDS/IPS, remote access) and cloud security services (Zscaler, Azure, AWS), plus experience with Zscaler ZDX and microsegmentation (Zscaler and/or Guardicore).
* Strong knowledge of the Fortinet security suite (FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) and experience testing and implementing security\-related changes in a production environment.
* Experience working with 3rd party vendors and managed network service providers.
* Great organisational skills.
* Strong experience of working on SIEM tools to analyze logs and correlate events.
* Solid understanding of industry standard Cybersecurity Frameworks and compliance requirements
* Experience in Enterprise level network security incidents and change Management process.
* Solid technical understanding of DMZs, security policies, secure application traffic flows, WAF, DDoS protection, SSL offloading and inspection.
* Strong knowledge of Zero Trust Network Architecture
* Experience with private and public cloud providers is a plus, (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP, Nutanix) particularly in connectivity, availability, resilience, and security.

description:
**About Us**


As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.


Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

**Overview about TII**


At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world\-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 5,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.

**Team Overview**


Our Search Team powers the real\-time experience that helps millions of guests find what they need whether they type one word or ask a complex question. We build low\-latency services, ranking pipelines and analytics that run both in our on\-prem data centers and on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Your work will let data scientists ship models to production quickly and reliably, so guests always get the right answer.

**Position Overview**


We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer who can independently solve complex technical problems, deliver production\-quality and maintainable solutions, and take end\-to\-end ownership of features and system reliability.


The role requires strong problem\-solving and technical expertise, including root\-cause analysis, system improvements, observability, fault\-tolerant design, and defensive engineering practices. The engineer will also identify and apply appropriate AI opportunities within products and engineering workflows while exercising sound judgment on automation and human oversight.


The ideal candidate will act as a subject matter expert in Search domain, understand concepts like search engines, query understanding, ranking, typeahead.


They will collaborate closely with engineers and stakeholders, clearly communicate and document technical decisions, lead solution\-design discussions, provide high\-quality technical feedback, and mentor team members in engineering best practices and domain knowledge.

**About You**

* 4 year degree or equivalent experience
* 5\-7 years of software development experience
* Code using primarily **Kotlin, Micronaut.**
* Experience with **Search Engines** like SOLR and Elasticsearch
* Experience in evaluating **search infrastructure** requirements and design/deploy solutions for problems such as **high availability, search clusters, elastic load** distribution.
* Experience on **streaming systems** like **Kafka.** Experience on Kafka Streams is added advantage.
